name: Report to Anastasia
label: Quest
description: Horde mages from across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms are called to the Undercity. Anastasia Hartwell has sensed an unknown magical disturbance there…

clips.title: The story
paras: Horde mages from across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms are called to the Undercity. Anastasia Hartwell has sensed an unknown magical disturbance there and needs capable spellcasters to investigate.

Horde mages hear of trouble in the Undercity. Those studying atop the bluffs of Thunder Bluff, in the dusty heat of Durotar, or among the ruins of Lordaeron receive the same call if they have enough skill. The Undercity's mages have sensed an unexplained disturbance within their domain and need help investigating it.

Anastasia Hartwell oversees arcane matters in the Undercity's Magic Quarter. She confirms that mages have detected strange energies within the city. No one knows whether the magic is harmless or hostile. Anastasia needs a capable mage to investigate quietly, beginning in the Apothecarium.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The mages of the Undercity have noted a magical disturbance within the city, and have sent word for mages of the Horde to investigate.
Anastasia Hartwell can tell you more. Speak with her in the Magic Quarter in the Undercity.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is true. A magical disturbance has been detected in our city. We are not yet sure of its origin, or whether it is malign or benign. We must first gather more information...
And that, friend, brings us to your task.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
